design.title: Design and build, spa
design.summary: A wet room with a freestanding tub, a steam shower behind a sealed door, a heated floor and a floating double vanity.
scope: Who is it for: Home
New construction, a remodel, or design and build: Design and build

Just the tub or shower, or the whole room: The whole bathroom

labor.name: Tear-out of the room
labor.why: Fixtures, tile and the floor out and hauled away, the walls opened to the studs where they're redone

labor.name: Tile walls (4 walls, about 196 sq ft of wall, typical size)
labor.why: Backer board, waterproofing, then tile and grout, wall by wall, with time for each to set
labor.size: about 196 sq ft of wall, typical size

labor.name: Valve and trim
labor.why: The rough-in valve replaced (or reused) while the walls are open, then the trim, heads and spout

labor.name: Body sprays
labor.why: Each spray piped on its own outlet, with a valve that has enough outlets

labor.name: Steam shower
labor.why: A generator in a nearby closet or vanity on its own circuit, the door sealed to a transom, the ceiling sloped so drips run down the wall

labor.name: Recessed niche
labor.why: Framed between the studs and waterproofed with the walls

labor.name: Built-in bench
labor.why: Framed, waterproofed and finished with the walls

labor.name: Custom frameless glass
labor.why: Measured after the walls are finished, then hung on a second trip

labor.name: Tub set
labor.why: Set level on a bed, connected to the drain and overflow

labor.name: Tile floor (about 147 sq ft of floor)
labor.why: The floor prepared, tile set and grouted

labor.name: Heated floor
labor.why: An electric mat laid and tested under the tile, a thermostat wired on its own circuit

labor.name: Vanity, top and faucet set
labor.why: The vanity set level, the top set, the faucet and drain connected

labor.name: Double vanity plumbing
labor.why: A second drain and a second set of supplies in the wall

labor.name: Toilet set
labor.why: A new wax seal and supply, set and checked on the flange

labor.name: Paint (about 394 sq ft painted, typical size)
labor.why: Patch, prime and two coats on the walls and ceiling outside the shower
labor.size: about 394 sq ft painted, typical size

labor.name: Exhaust fan
labor.why: The housing set in the ceiling, ducted outdoors and wired to its switch

labor.name: Supply lines and drains to the new layout
labor.why: Run to where each fixture goes while the walls and floor are open, then tested before they close

labor.name: Outlet, switches and boxes
labor.why: The vanity's GFCI outlet, the switches and their boxes wired while the walls are open, by a licensed electrician

labor.name: Drywall (about 307 sq ft of drywall, typical size)

labor.size: about 307 sq ft of drywall, typical size

labor.name: Cleanup
labor.why: A sweep-up each day and a final clean: dust down, fixtures and glass wiped, the floor protection taken up
